title: Add a transport-neutral developer message role
objective: Represent catalog snapshot and delta instructions as durable developer-role conversation messages without coupling to one provider.
context: Implement the accepted hybrid design: an initial developer-role catalog snapshot, append-only upsert/revoke deltas, on-demand SKILL.md bodies, and an authoritative execution registry.
The repository is a dirty shared worktree. Preserve unrelated changes and modify only owned_files.

source_evidence.note: Codex uses a bounded initial metadata catalog and loads full SKILL.md on demand.
Claude Code supports live skill discovery, visibility overrides, and on-demand skill bodies.
Append-only conversation messages preserve the previously cached prompt prefix.

include: Add RoleDeveloper and a DeveloperMessage constructor.
Add local metadata sufficient to identify catalog snapshot/delta revision and kind without exposing it to providers accidentally.
Update only Message.MarshalJSON and Message.UnmarshalJSON in types/tools.go so the new optional metadata survives persistence; preserve all unrelated tool serialization code.
Preserve JSON/session round trips and existing user/assistant behavior.
exclude: Do not modify files owned by another task.
Do not add dependencies or perform unrelated refactors.

implementation_steps: Extend the existing custom Message JSON wire shape with optional metadata while keeping legacy encodings byte-compatible when metadata is absent.
Verify old session JSON remains readable.
acceptance_criteria: Developer messages survive persistence and resume.
Existing user and assistant message encodings do not change.
Provider-specific downgrade behavior is not implemented here.
risks: Many packages assume only user/assistant roles; later compact and provider tasks must explicitly handle the new role.
types/tools.go is broad; task_02 ownership is intentionally limited to the Message JSON methods and must not touch other serialization paths.
dispatch_prompt: Add and test an internal RoleDeveloper message representation in types/messages.go. Preserve backward compatibility; do not edit providers or compact code.
notes_for_assignee: Keep the diff narrow; if a dependency contract is insufficient, report the required change to the integrator instead of editing another task's files.
